newsitem.title: CANADA: Adrian seen announcing Petaquilla plans.
newsitem.headline: Adrian seen announcing Petaquilla plans.

text.p: Adrian Resources Ltd was expected to announce on Wednesday efforts to improve economics at its Petaquilla copper-gold property in Panama, an official at a partner company said.
Adrian stock was halted pending a news release, which the company said would be issued within a few hours.

"I think what it will focus on is some additional follow-up work at the property to see if the economics can be improved by looking at some additional issues," said Mike Lipkewich, senior vice president of mining operations at Teck Corp, which is participating in the project.

Lipkewich declined to discuss details of the planned work, but Teck said previously it hoped to look for higher grade ore at the site. Lipkewich said the latest development appeared to have eased tensions among the partners -- Adrian, Teck and Inmet Mining Corp.
Adrian, which controls 52 percent of the discovery, had criticized a feasibility study on the property done by Teck, saying it was incomplete.
Teck, which has an option to acquire up to 26 percent of the project, defended the study and last month contended that a mine would not be economic in current market conditions.
Asked if Wednesday's expected announcement of additional work had resolved Adrian's dissatisfaction, Lipkewich said: "My interpretation would be yes."
Inmet, which controls 48 percent of Petaquilla, had backed Teck's assessment of mine feasibility.
Adrian said previously the Petaquilla property contained reserves of 13.74 billion pounds of copper and 3.17 million ounces of gold within 1.46 billion tonnes of ore.
Adrian was down 0.14 to 2.25 in Toronto today before the halt.
